note: Passage 3711 (Pro 1:20) — personified Wisdom (chokmot) cries aloud in the street. Read as characteristic: wisdom itself, personified, in active public appeal to the simple (the IB good made a voice). Personification noted.

dims.v: Wisdom personified — wisdom as a woman crying aloud in the street
Wisdom crying aloud, raising her voice in the public square to summon the simple
the simple/scoffers/fools she addresses (from the following verses)

a decisive shift: wisdom, the object gained in 1:2-9, becomes a SUBJECT that actively seeks — personified, she pursues the simple in the streets. The IB good is not passive; it appeals. Read as characteristic (wisdom-in-action) with the personification noted; manner marked (public, loud).
